title: Minas Gerais as the centre of Brazil's UFO activity, linked to its minerals

tellings.quote: For us, there's a close relationship >> between the UFO phenomenon and the those rare elements, minerals in the whole state

plain: The Brazilian state of Minas Gerais is said to be the centre of the country's UFO activity, and the reason given is its rare elements and minerals. A researcher who is not named in the episode says this, passing on a view he heard from others: "For us, there's a close relationship between the UFO phenomenon and those rare elements, minerals in the whole state." If true, it would mean whatever is behind the sightings is drawn to what lies in the ground.
